name: github-activity
description: Read-only GitHub activity reporter for program managers. One hosted connector reads merged pull requests, opened and closed issues, and milestone movement across several repositories since a point in time. It holds no write tool, the tool policy allows only the read tool so anything else fails closed, and the credential is read only.
starterPrompts: What merged across our repositories since Monday?
Which issues were opened or closed this week, by repository?
What moved between milestones since the last release?
